981: Do you deliver outside São Paulo?
982: Yes. The factory is in Limeira/SP and we deliver all over Brazil. Our customer base has operations from Rondônia to Ceará. Freight goes into the proposal together with the equipment.
983: Can it be built to the length and height of my operation?
984: Yes. Most of what leaves the factory is adjusted in length, belt width, discharge height and belt type. If the layout calls for something different from the catalog, it becomes a special project.
985: Which belt to use for fertilizer, grain or bags?
986: It depends on the material and the incline: smooth belt on flat sections, cleated or V belt when there is elevation and loose material, sanitary PVC for food. Our engineering team specifies it in the proposal.
987: What is the best time to install?
988: We recommend closing the project in the off-season or before the receiving peak, so assembly does not compete for space with a full operation.
989: And after delivery, who provides service?
990: Our own team. Technical service, spare parts and preventive maintenance guidance stay with Demakine; we do not outsource after-sales.
